aboutGame.title: What is UPD Build An Empire?
paragraphs: UPD Build An Empire is a Roblox empire-building and progression experience developed by The Art of Games and LoordySir. You start on a tiny plot of land and expand it into a sprawling empire of farms, mines, houses, and castles while a growing population of civilians works your territory. Resources are produced, sold for gold, and reinvested into research that unlocks stronger buildings and stacking bonuses.

The long game is conquest. Six empires compete for dominance in each persistent world, so you recruit soldiers, Giants, Medics, and siege weapons to defend your land, capture flags, and hold territory. Empire Level ties the whole loop together, and because your empire keeps producing while you are offline, steady sessions beat occasional grinding.

modules.name: UPD Build An Empire Codes
modules.description: Where UPD Build An Empire codes and permanent bonuses come from, how redemption works in Roblox experiences, and which rewards you can claim today.

highlights.label: No Active Codes
highlights.detail: No public codes have been released yet, so the group and Premium sell bonuses are the rewards available today.

highlights.label: +10% Group
highlights.detail: Joining the game's official Roblox group grants a free, permanent +10% sell value bonus.

highlights.label: +5% Premium
highlights.detail: Premium adds a further +5% sell value that stacks on top of the group bonus and research upgrades.

modules.name: UPD Build An Empire Beginner Guide
modules.description: A step-by-step opening checklist for your first 15 minutes, covering production, housing, selling, research, and when to buy more land.

highlights.detail: Place your first production building, because nothing else functions without an income stream.
Add a second production building of a different type to smooth out your early cash flow.
Build basic housing so civilians can staff the buildings you just placed.
Sell your first batch of resources to convert stored goods into spending power.
Buy your first research upgrade, since a small bonus now compounds for the rest of the session.
Expand your land only when your existing plots are running out of space.

highlights.label: Output

highlights.label: Sell
highlights.detail: Sell resources in batches with the group and Premium bonuses active instead of hoarding them.

highlights.label: Level
highlights.detail: Push Empire Level, because it gates stronger buildings, unit tiers, and passive bonuses.

highlights.label: Army
highlights.detail: Build a mixed army once your economy can fund it, not before it can pay for itself.

faq.title: UPD Build An Empire FAQ
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about UPD Build An Empire on Roblox.

items.question: What is UPD Build An Empire?
items.answer: UPD Build An Empire is a free-to-play Roblox empire-building experience by The Art of Games and LoordySir. You start with a tiny plot of land and grow it into a sprawling empire by building farms, mines, houses, and castles, producing resources, researching upgrades, and raising your Empire Level.

items.question: Does UPD Build An Empire have codes?
items.answer: No public UPD Build An Empire codes have been released yet, and the game's own description highlights Premium perks and group bonuses instead. Until a code system arrives, the reliable rewards are the free +10% group sell bonus and the +5% Premium bonus.

items.question: How do I make money fast in UPD Build An Empire?
items.answer: Keep farms and mines staffed, sell resources in batches with the group and Premium bonuses active, and reinvest the gold into more production. Because your empire keeps working offline, logging in to claim and reinvest the stockpile is one of the fastest ways to grow.

items.question: How do I build an army in UPD Build An Empire?
items.answer: Fund your economy first, then recruit soldiers, Giants, Medics, and siege weapons. Send Giants in first, follow with Soldiers, keep Medics behind the line, and use siege weapons to break fortifications and support flag captures.

items.question: Does UPD Build An Empire keep running while I am offline?
items.answer: Yes. Your empire keeps producing resources while you are away, so returning players usually find accumulated goods waiting. Log in to claim them, sell with your bonuses active, and reinvest into the next upgrade.

items.question: What should I upgrade first in UPD Build An Empire?
items.answer: Prioritize farms and mines for immediate income, then Empire Level to unlock stronger buildings, then housing for population. Research and army upgrades come once your production base can pay for them.
